title: Platform command to a ground station
description: One object per message on cmd/gsu/{station_id}. A command is a request, never a guarantee: the platform confirms nothing itself and waits to see the effect in the station's own telemetry. Every command below therefore has a field in a telemetry payload that reports its result - if you add a command, add that field too. Unknown commands must be ignored, not rejected: an older station and a newer platform have to coexist.

freq_hz.description: Already snapped to the nearest kHz by the platform. Reported back as radio.freq_hz.

db.description: Fixed threshold. Setting one implies leaving AUTO, exactly as moving the slider does on a real receiver.

on.description: On: ride 8 dB above the measured floor. Off: FREEZE the threshold where it was - do not keep tracking, or the control appears to do nothing.
Momentary squelch defeat - the MON button. Station-wide: there is one gate, so this pushes hiss to every listener. Expected to be held, never latched.

gain.description: Site configuration, set once. Prefer fixed: the tuner AGC desenses near strong transmitters badly enough that a stronger signal reads lower.

ppm.description: Crystal correction, trimmed once at commissioning.

on.description: Reported back as light.on once the hardware has actually done it.
